answer: A tide erodes an unused canal, and every registered identity pays 6% per-epoch demurrage on idle stake: a clone farm parking 1,000 identities with a 500-credit stake each loses 30,000 credits per epoch unless each clone performs verified work. The honest agent runs one identity, earns 90 credits per epoch, and the decay is fully covered by that reward, so the cost lands only on capital left idle. Sybil scale multiplies the bleed, since N clones drain N x 30 credits per epoch, and the pigment of genuine work is what keeps an identity's balance from freezing like an untouched glacier.
